name: needs-triage
description: The owner needs to evaluate this issue; a temporary fallback

name: needs-info
description: Waiting on the reporter for more information

name: ready-for-agent
description: Fully specified; an agent can do it unattended

name: ready-for-human
description: Needs a human to implement or decide in person

name: enhancement
description: New or changed behaviour, tooling or structure

name: investigation
description: Bounded research or measurement that ends with evidence, conclusions and unknowns

name: verification
description: Dedicated acceptance or verification work; feature issues keep their own checks

name: epic
description: A larger outcome delivered through sub-issues

name: decision-needed
description: The owner must decide before the work can finish
